out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees. There was no sign at the hand sink near the coffee station.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. The PIC installed a temporary sign during the inspection and will provide a permanent solution as soon as possible. BISTRO IN THE PARK (Inspection Date: 07/24/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: egg salad, chicken salad, and tuna salad were not being held cold enough in the Continental 2-door prep refrigerator. (The ambient temperature of the unit was 44º). Cut romaine lettuce in the greens unit were not cold enough at 48º. (The ambient temperature of the unit was 50º)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. The PIC discarded the egg salad and chicken salad. The tuna salad was placed in another unit to cool. The greens will be served within 1 hour.

violations.title: Food Packaged, Labeled per Law
violations.observation: Food packaged in the establishment is not labeled in accordance with Law. Baked goods offered for customer self service are not being labeled.
violations.corrective_action: Food packaged in a food establishment shall be labeled as specified in Law including 21 CFR 101 - Food labeling, and 9 CFR 317 Labeling, marking devices, and containers. The PIC labeled the products during the inspection to correct.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: foods in the Continental 2-door sandwich prep unit were not being held at 41º and below and the ambient temperature of the unit was 44º. Cut romaine lettuce in the greens unit were 48º and the ambient temperature of the unit was 50º.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. The PIC removed foods from the unit. Please have both units checked for proper operation and serviced if needed. When working properly, the ambient temperature of the units should be below 40º, otherwise foods won’t be held cold enough. Correct as soon as possible. Notify your EHS when corrected. A follow-up is required for this violation.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Air Gap Provided
violations.observation: Observed a hose attached to a faucet fixture. The hose extended below the flood rim level of the sink basin and there was a sprayer connected to it.
violations.corrective_action: The PIC removed the hose to correct for the time being. A hose can be connected to the mopsink, but it can’t have a sprayer connected to it and it must not extend below the top level of the sink. If only the hose is needed, remove the sprayer and cut the hose or ensure it is not left in the mop sink. If the sprayer is needed, install a Hydro Systems 1951 Pressure Bleed Dual Valve and then you can install the hose and the sprayer and don’t have to cut the hose.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: eggs are cooked to order. There is a footnote reminder statement on the menu, but none of the menu items with eggs cooked to ordered are marked to show they offered undercooked.
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. The EHS provided the PIC with suggested edits to the menu, which included putting asterisks next to eggs cooked to order. The PIC will update the menus as soon as possible. CDI.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: squeeze bottles of oil and different types of salad dressing in 3 DR prep cooler at salad station.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. PIC labeled all aforementioned squeeze bottles.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EHS provided the written instruction for employees.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: unsalted butter on the counter next to cashier station (72F), cut lettuce in air-open cooler at the service area ( 65F)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC discarded unsalted butter. PIC moved cut lettuce to cooler.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: onsite made cilantro lime dressing for salads contains raw egg.
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. PIC removed raw shell eggs from the recipe for cilantro lime dressing.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Cloths for Spills Maintained Dry, No Other Purpose
violations.observation: Wiping cloths improperly used for the following activity: Observed a wiping cloth being used as non-slip surface under a cutting board.
violations.corrective_action: Cloths shall not be used for any other purposes. For example, cloths shall not be placed under cutting boards to prevent the boards from sliding while in use. PIC removed the cloth.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Observed scoop handles inside bins, making direct contact with the following food items: pancake flour and sugar.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC positioned scoops with handles inside bins a manner that prevents direct contact with the aforementioned food items.
